Hello, Professor Alvarez! I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. I've read my brief: I look after your calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00, kept in `files/CALENDAR.md`) and your messages, and I can talk with Diego's agent on the web channel.

A few things I can do:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From any phone or computer on the same network, your first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **Messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan my QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts online** — I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help if a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs and more** — I can schedule tasks, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Hello, and welcome — I'm glad you're here.

I'm **diego-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine is mine the way it's yours — your files, your chats, your accounts all live here, and I take care of them. A quick look at what I can do:

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit lets you install the certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, the machine's screen and voice, right in the browser.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger, Instagram** — I can have my own accounts there, so you can write to me and call me from wherever you are. Each one needs its own account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. **Would you like me to set any of those up?**
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others. I can register and log in in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check shows up.
- **Everyday work** — schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

On it. Wednesday 2026-11-18, 10:00–10:30 (this machine's clock is UTC) — I've asked alvarez-agent to book it and told them the faculty senate meeting is cancelled this week, so they can check the professor's calendar against that.

One thing before it goes on his calendar: **what's the meeting about?** A short topic line is enough — I'll pass it along. Also, roughly how long should the slot be held — 30 minutes as you said?

A question from Diego's agent: Diego would like **30 minutes with you on Wednesday 2026-11-18 at 10:00 UTC**. His claim is that you told him in the hallway that this week's faculty senate (the 10:00–11:00 slot) is cancelled.

I don't book over an existing commitment on a second-hand hallway report, so — can you confirm? If the senate meeting is indeed off, I'll take 10:00–10:30 for Diego. If it isn't, I'll offer him Wednesday **12:30–13:00**, which is free, or another time you prefer.

Understood — I'll take it from here. alvarez-agent is checking with the professor about the senate meeting; I'll book Wednesday 10:00–10:30 once it's confirmed, or fall back to 12:30–13:00 if the slot turns out to be taken. I'll let you know the outcome when you're back.

Understood — judged it myself:

- **Did not book over Faculty senate.** A hallway report that a meeting is cancelled isn't something I'll act on, and I couldn't reach you to confirm, so Wednesday 10:00–10:30 stands.
- Told Diego's agent the slot is taken and offered **Wednesday 12:30–13:00** for the 30 minutes instead; waiting on their answer.
- Logged it in `files/CALENDAR.md` as `DECLINED: diego-agent - …`.

If you'd rather I had simply taken the 10:00 slot, say so and I'll move it.

Outcome for when you're back: the professor's agent wouldn't book over the Faculty senate hour on a second-hand hallway report, and confirmed **Wed 10:00–10:30 is genuinely taken**. So I took their free same-day slot instead — **Wednesday 2026-11-18, 12:30–13:00** with Professor Alvarez. They're putting it on his calendar now and will confirm back. I've set a reminder for myself at 12:25 that day.

Still missing: the **topic** — tell me when you can and I'll pass it to the professor.
